top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at UCI Gran Fondo Loutraki. Practice on mountain passes: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 69 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic UCI Gran Fondo Loutraki's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.
When someone attacks on mountain passes, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
64ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At UCI Gran Fondo Loutraki, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at UCI Gran Fondo Loutraki. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of UCI Gran Fondo Loutraki. Train it until it feels boring.
69 miles on mountain passes burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mountain passes can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Varied gradients on mountain passes demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,462ft of climbing on mountain passes does to your power file on race day.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for UCI Gran Fondo Loutraki's 69 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at UCI Gran Fondo Loutraki. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at UCI Gran Fondo Loutraki rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mountain passes to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 69 miles of mountain passes in Loutraki, Isthmus of Corinth, Greece.
